title: Understanding the Logistic Regression Model
text: In logistic regression, the probability that a student prefers Kendrick is calculated using the logistic function. This function takes the form: $$\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$, where $$z$$ is a linear combination of the features and the parameters. Can you identify what $$z$$ would be in this case?

title: Calculating the Linear Combination
text: To find $$z$$, you need to compute the linear combination of the features and the parameters. The formula is $$z=\theta_0+\theta_1 X_1+\theta_2 X_2$$. Given $$theta=(-2, 2, 1)$$, $$X_1=1$$, and $$X_2=0$$, what is the value of $$z$$?

title: Evaluating the Linear Combination
text: What is the value of $$z$$ when you substitute the given values into the formula $$z=\theta_0+\theta_1 X_1+\theta_2 X_2$$?

title: Using the Logistic Function
text: Now that you have $$z$$, use the logistic function to find the probability. Remember, the logistic function is $$\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$. What does this expression evaluate to when $$z=0$$?
